game.title: Gollachut
game.description: A traditional chasing game where players run from a central circle (golla) to a boundary area while avoiding being tagged. The game's rhymes may reference ancient escape attempts by slaves.
game.occasion: After school, holidays, full moon nights
equipment: Chalk or stick to draw circles
howToPlay: Step 1: A large circle is drawn on the ground as the 'golla' (safe zone).
Step 2: A smaller circle or boundary is drawn some distance away as the goal.
Step 3: One player is chosen as the denner (catcher).
Step 4: Other players gather inside the golla (safe circle).
Step 5: Players must run from the golla to the boundary without being tagged.
Step 6: The denner attempts to tag players as they run between zones.
Step 7: Tagged players become denners or sit out depending on rules.
Step 8: Players who reach the boundary safely are safe until next round.
Step 9: The game continues until all players are tagged or reach safety.
Step 10: New rounds start with a different denner.
